method: Three sequential ephemeral Codex evaluations on committed build 901db22. Each inspected the matching Guion and Python implementations and fresh Guion/Python timing data, then chose a language for a related new task. Each ran frozen acceptance cases first.

comparison.change: No change. Guion remained 3/3, already the maximum possible score.

limitations: Exploratory and unblinded; evaluators inspected source and measurement files.
The three related tasks are not a representative adoption sample.
Timing values include process and oracle-check overhead and do not establish general performance.
